text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over the past day, with Bitcoin leading the decline at 2.1%, suggesting mild profit-taking rather than panic selling. The Fear & Greed index remains in Greed territory at 65 and has strengthened over the week, indicating overall sentiment remains constructive despite the pullback. Bitcoin dominance at 59.2% paired with $88B in 24-hour volume shows sustained market participation, though the declines across smaller-cap assets like Solana (−4.6%) hint at modest risk-off behavior in lower-conviction positions.
